This composes ADDITIVELY with any other charge-speed buff instead of clamping — under a stacked charge-speed team it will UNDER-clamp (real charge stays pinned at 0.7s). ⚑ skill2 block 3 target 'self and all allies with lower final DEF than self' has NO schema equivalent. Approximated as all allies (she is a Defender, so she is normally the highest-DEF unit). Over-credits any team carrying a HIGHER-DEF ally.

⚑ Shooting Stars crit: encoded as a DoT with the default crit-OFF exemption per the priors (DoT crit is opt-in only where MEASURED). The line reads as repeating ATTACKS, so crit:true is plausible; read popup colours (orange = crit) before flipping it.

The skill1 burst-CDR line activates 'at the start of battle AND when Full Burst ends'. Only the fullBurstEnd instance is modeled: at t=0 every ally's burst cooldown is already 0, so the battle-start application is inert. Revisit if the engine ever starts allies on cooldown.
noFb is NOT set anywhere (FB-by-timing default ON per prior 2); noRange is engine-automatic and never authored.
The two 'Cancels ...' lines are enforced STRUCTURALLY by the mutually exclusive formation gates (noB1 / hasB1) rather than as effects, so the two Star states can never co-apply.
